summary: Point 5 is remediated in the local implementation: moderation is a typed, server-owned field independent of member publishing. Create, update, removal and replacement bypasses are covered by emulator regression tests. Overall rules score remains 2 because the previously identified shared-tag permissions are outside this change. Production has not been updated.

Existing tag field bounds and aggregate upload quotas remain outside this moderation change.
